cases.title: Zero-order category silently missing from a monthly report
cases.sql:
SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  COALESCE(COUNT(o.order_id), 0) AS order_count
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN products AS p
  ON p.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
 AND o.order_date >= '2025-12-01'
 AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY c.name ASC;

cases.title: Individuals leaderboard topped by corporations
cases.sql:
SELECT
  c.full_name AS customer_full_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.entity_type IN (7, 8)
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.full_name ASC
LIMIT 5;

cases.title: Guessed entity_type code returns zero rows dressed as an answer
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <  '2026-01-01'
  AND c.entity_type IN (7, 8);

cases.title: Absolute growth question answered with percentage growth
cases.sql:
SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
   SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS absolute_increase
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY absolute_increase DESC
LIMIT 1;

cases.title: Order counts inflated by item-level JOIN fan-out
cases.sql:
SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM categories c
JOIN products p
  ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN order_items oi
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <  '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 0
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.name ASC;

cases.title: Monthly trend missing the month that had nothing
cases.sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT '2025-01' AS month UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-03' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-04'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2025-05' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-06' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-07' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-08'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2025-09' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-10' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-11' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-12'
),
garden_orders AS (
  SELECT
    substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.name = 'garden'
    AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7)
)
SELECT
  m.month AS month,
  COALESCE(go.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN garden_orders go ON go.month = m.month
ORDER BY m.month;

cases.title: Top customers ranking swallowed by a NULL bucket
cases.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c.company_name IS NULL THEN c.full_name
    ELSE c.company_name
  END AS customer_display_name,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN c.company_name IS NULL THEN c.full_name
    ELSE c.company_name
  END
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

cases.title: Top-3 ranking with a tie at third place
cases.sql:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.name = 'toys'
    AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    product_name,
    units_sold,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units_sold DESC) AS units_rank
  FROM sales
)
SELECT
  product_name,
  units_sold
FROM ranked
WHERE units_rank <= 3
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, product_name ASC;
